name: Amethyst
notes:
It can run islanded from the national grid

New Zealand Designed Six-Jet Vertical Pelton Turbine

The original 250 kW Amethyst Power Station, which was developed to supply the Harihari area, was commissioned in 1954 and decommissioned in 1991. It took water from the same river and was situated approximately 1 km upstream from the current site. Grade B (Westpower). Wikipedia 7.6 MW, 2013.
